criteria.title: Objectives
criteria.body:
Choose priorities: lower inflation, a longer issuance horizon,
and longer staking commitments.

criteria.title: KPIs
criteria.body:
Measure issuance, duration and participation.
Choose which participation measures are safeguards.

criteria.title:
Acceptance
thresholds
criteria.body:
Choose the minimum conditions a design must meet.
BCRG’s current thresholds are working assumptions.

criteria.title:
Preference
weights
criteria.body:
Use utilities and the combined score to rank trade-offs.
A high combined score can still fail a threshold.
